question:
The IUPAC name of following compound is _________.

 {CH}₃{CHBrCH}₂{CH}₂{CH}₃ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**2-Bromopentane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The compound given in the question is CH₃CHBrCH₂CH₂CH₃. The structure represents a **pentane chain** with a bromine atom attached to the second carbon.
 
• In **IUPAC nomenclature**, the parent chain is selected as the longest continuous chain of carbon atoms, which in this case is "pentane" as it has five carbon atoms.
